cues.heading: Take a steady hold
cues.text: Stand tall, holding a stable worktop for support.

cues.heading: Bend behind you
cues.text: Bend your exercise knee and bring that heel up behind you.

cues.heading: Keep your thighs aligned
cues.text: Keep your thighs beside each other. Avoid leaning or arching your back.

cues.heading: Return your foot
cues.text: Slowly lower your foot until it rests on the floor again.

cues.heading: Stay within your range
cues.text: Keep holding the support. Do not force the bend.

cues.heading: Follow your plan
cues.text: Only do this if prescribed. Use your own repetitions and holds.
